# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148. This release supersedes the 4.147.x previews and lands all v4 changes cumulatively: variable font and color palette support, animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData for zero-copy I/O, and a rewritten singleton lifecycle. It is a breaking release — see the changes below before upgrading from 3.x.

## Breaking Changes

- **`new SKFont()` now uses an empty typeface (no lazy default)** — Upstream Skia m132 removed lazy default-typeface resolution. `new SKFont().Typeface` is now `SKTypeface.Empty` (0 glyphs), so `MeasureText` returns 0 and nothing is drawn. Pass an explicit typeface: `new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)`. Detect the unset state with `font.Typeface.IsEmpty` instead of `font.Typeface == null`.
- **`new SKPaint().Typeface` returns `SKTypeface.Default` instead of null** — Text measurement and drawing still work out of the box — SkiaSharp seeds the default font — but `paint.Typeface == null` no longer fires. Use `paint.Typeface.IsEmpty` or drop the check (a usable default is always present).
- **`SKTypeface.FromFamilyName("missing")` returns Default instead of null on Android** — All platforms now return `SKTypeface.Default` for an unknown family (Android used to return null). For strict null semantics, use `SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name, style)` which still returns null on no match.
- **`SKStream.Move(long)` now throws `OverflowException` and is obsolete** — The native offset is 32-bit. The `Move(long)` overload now uses a checked cast and is marked `[Obsolete]`. Call `Move(int)` instead, validating or clamping large values first. Most callers only need the obsolete-warning fix.
- **Vulkan 1.0 now aborts the process instead of returning null from `GRContext.CreateVulkan`** — Skia Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1. A Vulkan 1.0 instance or a `GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion` of 0 causes Skia to call `SK_ABORT` — the process terminates. Set `apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_1` in your `VkApplicationInfo` and set `MaxAPIVersion` on `GRVkBackendContext` to the same value.
- **`GRVkBackendContextNative` — five interop fields removed** — Removed: `fMinAPIVersion`, `fInstanceVersion`, `fExtensions`, `fFeatures`, `fOwnsInstanceAndDevice`. Delete those assignments. Use `fVkExtensions` in place of `fExtensions` and `fDeviceFeatures`/`fDeviceFeatures2` in place of `fFeatures`.
- **`GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo` retyped; `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo` loses value-equality** — The property type changed from `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo` to `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`. The old struct no longer implements `IEquatable` or equality operators. Update code that compared values or matched the old type name.
- **`SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose` setter removed** — The protected setter on `IgnorePublicDispose` has been removed. Subclasses that wrote to it must be updated; the property is now get-only.
- **Pre-v4 obsolete APIs promoted to errors; obsolete enums trimmed** — All APIs that were `[Obsolete]` warnings in 3.x — including the SKPaint text/font members — are now errors in 4.x and removed from the ref assembly. Remove all `#pragma warning disable CS0618` suppressions and migrate to the replacement APIs. ([#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205), [#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114))

## Engine

- **Skia upgraded from m132/m147 through to m148** — The Skia engine was bumped through milestones 132, 133, 147, and finally 148, delivering Skia's latest rendering engine improvements, including several upstream chrome/m147 bug-fix syncs. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081))
- **Variable font and color palette support** — Full variable font axis support and color font palette APIs are now available in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, enabling OpenType `fvar`/`HVAR` fonts and COLRv1 color palettes. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding (SKWebpEncoder)** — A new `SKWebpEncoder` API allows encoding multi-frame animated WebP files from C#. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **`SKStream.GetData()` — zero-copy stream-to-data conversion** — A new `SKStream.GetData()` method wraps the native stream contents as an `SKData` without copying, useful for efficiently accessing encoded image bytes. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **`SKSurface.Draw` and `SKCanvas.DrawSurface` gain `SKSamplingOptions`** — Both surface-drawing methods now accept an `SKSamplingOptions` argument, giving fine-grained control over resampling quality. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))

## API Surface

- **HarfBuzzSharp gains `HBColor` struct and missing API wrappers** — A dedicated `HBColor` struct now correctly represents `hb_color_t`, and several missing HarfBuzz wrappers and naming-convention fixes have been added. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **Linux Bionic native asset support** — Native assets for Linux Bionic (Android-flavored Linux used in some embedded and ChromeOS contexts) are now included in the NuGet package. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Tizen x64 and arm64 native builds added** — The Tizen platform now ships x64 and arm64 native binaries in addition to the existing arm build. ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKPixmap/SKBitmap `GetPixelSpan` row-stride and offset fixes** — `GetPixelSpan` now correctly uses `RowBytes` for stride instead of `Width × BytesPerPixel`, fixing corruption on images with padding. A related off-by-one in `GetPixelSpan<T>(x,y)` that used Height instead of Width for the offset is also fixed. ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128))
- **SKPath finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first** — A use-after-free in the finalizer thread, where an `SKPath` outlived its underlying `SKPathBuilder`, is fixed. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **`SKTypeface.Default` Android crash on API 36+ fixed** — On Android API 36+ the font manager could return null for `matchFamilyStyle(null, Normal)`, crashing on access. The fallback now yields `SKTypeface.Empty` instead of throwing. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9 fixed** — Consumers of WinUI / WinAppSDK on .NET 9 no longer see a DLL-not-found error at startup. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))
- **Android `SKGLView` rendering after MAUI TabBar tab switch fixed** — A long-standing issue where the GL view stopped rendering after switching tabs in a MAUI `TabBar` on Android has been resolved. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))
- **Apple platform TFMs corrected: 26.0 for libraries, unversioned for apps** — Library TFMs now use the versioned `net9.0-ios26.0` form while app TFMs use the unversioned `net9.0-ios` form, matching Apple's framework conventions. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton lifecycle completely reworked** — The `SKObject` singleton registry has been redesigned to be re-entrant and thread-safe, eliminating races and crashes seen when singletons (e.g., `SKColorSpace.Srgb`) were accessed from multiple threads or after disposal. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Native-compat gate moved from `[ModuleInitializer]` to `SkiaApi` cctor** — The startup version check that guards against binary incompatibility now runs in the `SkiaApi` class constructor, making it compatible with trimming and AOT scenarios that strip module initializers. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))
- **Warnings-as-errors enabled across all binding projects** — All C# warnings in `binding/` are now treated as errors, and pre-existing warnings have been resolved, ensuring clean builds going forward. ([#3752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3752))

## Security

- **Native dependency updates: libpng, libexpat, freetype, libjpeg-turbo, zlib, HarfBuzz** — libpng was updated to 1.6.58, libexpat to 2.7.5 (and later 2.8.1), freetype to 2.14.3, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, and zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley — picking up security and bug fixes across all bundled native libraries. HarfBuzz was updated to 14.2.0. ([#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 ships with this release, adding variable font axis support, color palette APIs, and the new `HBColor` struct for correct `hb_color_t` representation.
